scope: One fresh Dell development case on the existing as-of data plane; limits are safety ceilings, not target call counts. No old answer seed. New vision/attachment/export tooling requires separate qualification before inclusion.

cost_expectation_cny.basis: 2026-09-07 qualification estimate: prior eight-worker research ~6.63 CNY, cross-paper review ~1.92, targeted author repair/report ~1.98, plus new Lead synthesis/independent research review ~1-3 based on comparable Pro/low review inputs, and modest task/revision variability. Plan 12-20 CNY for the first fresh complete case; not measured price, no guaranteed savings.
